newsitem.title: USA: Walgreen February same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Walgreen February same-store sales up.

text.p: Walgreen Co said Tuesday its same-store sales for February increased 6.2 percent from a year ago. Total sales rose 11.6 percent, to $1.08 billion from $964.1 million.
The company said last year's results benefitted from an extra selling day, February 29.
Comparing 28 days this February to 28 days in February 1996, total sales increased 15 percent and same-store sales increased 9.5 percent, it said.
Pharmacy sales, which account for 45 percent of overall sales, rose 15 percent, while comparable-pharmacy sales advanced 10 percent.
Calendar year-to-date sales were $2.17 billion, up 13.2 percent from $1.92 billion in 1996.
Fiscal year-to-date sales for the six months were $6.66 billion, up 13.4 percent from $5.87 billion.
At February 28, the company operated 2,256 drugstores, compared to 2,131 a year ago.
